test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 5th July 2021 The Department of School Education and Literacy launched the __ __ national mission aiming to achieve universal foundational literacy and numeracy in primary classes in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NIPUN Bharat**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **5th July 2021**, the **Department of School Education and Literacy** launched the **NIPUN Bharat** mission, aiming to achieve **universal foundational literacy and numeracy** in primary classes in India by **2026-27**.
 
• **NIPUN Bharat** stands for **National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy**. 
 
• The mission focuses on improving the basic learning skills of children in **grades 1 to 3**, ensuring that every child achieves foundational literacy and numeracy by the end of grade 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital India**: A flagship program launched in 2015 to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)**: This is a skill development initiative under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship to provide employable skills to the youth, not focused on school education.
 
• **Smart Class**: Refers to the use of technology and digital tools in classrooms, but it is not a specific national mission launched on the stated date.
